root_causes: Planting was restricted to stations below700m or above4650m; the opening sequence, Koval, Sphere and Sands had none.
Fixed18m building-midpoint culling removed the entire Wynn retail/Plaza footprint despite adequate actual road clearance.
Ordinary low-rise buildings used repeated hotel window grids and lacked street-level glazing, balconies, canopies and venue structures.
48m fixture spacing and dark material attenuation produced dull surfaces; the first24m fixture trial clipped the light field and made the road uniformly pale.
Flamingo and Cosmopolitan compound outlines were extruded to tower height, filling whole properties with unsupported tall walls.
An eighteen-row Strip grandstand extended through the mapped Harrahs facade and concealed its street entrance.
Sponsor UV runs continued across material boundaries and cut through words.
The hospitality gallery used opaque window bands, hiding interior depth.
Retail podium windows stretched from ground to full building height, producing enormous blank panes instead of separate shop floors.
Grand Chateau reused Palazzo room windows; Signature used a generic green window grid and flat crown.
The Harmon Corner LED covered the three-storey retail facade instead of being mounted above it.
